content.short: Renegades Republic is an AAA FPS game on Cardano with tradable NFT assets and dystopian 3D environments.
content.description: Renegades Republic is a high-end Web3 gaming project on Cardano, featuring a fast-paced AAA first-person shooter (FPS) set in a dystopian future. Built using Unreal Engine 5, the game offers immersive 3D environments where players have true ownership of their digital gear, including characters and weapons, through tradable NFTs. The project focuses on bridging the gap between traditional gaming and blockchain technology, providing a competitive ecosystem where skills are rewarded. With exclusive benefits for OG Emerald Card holders, Renegades Republic is defining the next level of gaming.
